title: AlignPoison: Conditional Targeted Poisoning of Generative Recommenders via Decoding-Aligned Prefixes
abstract: arXiv:2610.14487v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative recommendation models based on autoregressive decoding have been adopted as alternatives to classical ranking-based systems. While their modeling flexibility has been widely studied, their resilience to data poisoning remains largely unexplored. In this work, we ask: how susceptible are generative recommenders to conditional targeted poisoning? Under a realistic setting where an adversary can inject limited malicious interactions and query a recommendation API as a black box, our empirical study shows that generative recommenders are vulnerable: injecting fewer than 1% synthetic interactions significantly increases the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under the trigger. To characterize this vulnerability, we analyze the synthesis of malicious interactions from two perspectives: (i) decoding alignment and (ii) prefix popularity. translated_title: AlignPoison：通过解码对齐前缀对生成式推荐系统进行条件性定向投毒
translated_abstract: 基于自回归解码的生成式推荐模型已被采用作为经典基于排序系统的替代方案。尽管其建模灵活性已被广泛研究，但其对数据投毒的抵抗能力在很大程度上仍未被探索。在这项工作中，我们提出这样一个问题：生成式推荐系统对条件性定向投毒有多脆弱？在攻击者可以注入有限恶意交互并以黑盒方式查询推荐API的现实设置下，我们的实证研究表明生成式推荐系统是脆弱的：注入少于1%的合成交互就能显著提高在触发条件下推广恶意目标的可能性。为了刻画这种脆弱性，我们从两个角度分析恶意交互的合成：(i) 解码对齐和 前缀流行度。我们观察到，在模型诱导分布下既常见又与上下文对齐的简短前缀……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 生成式推荐系统对条件性定向投毒高度脆弱，攻击者仅需注入不到1%精心构造的、具有解码对齐且高流行度前缀的合成交互，即可在触发条件下显著提高推广恶意目标的概率。
en_tdlr: Generative recommenders are highly vulnerable to conditional targeted poisoning: an attacker can significantly increase the likelihood of promoting malicious targets under a trigger by injecting fewer than 1% of synthetic interactions crafted with decoding-aligned and popular prefixes.
